description: This file contains functions for generating sales payment summary reports, including data retrieval, formatting columns, and handling different payment modes and invoice data within an ERP system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_pos_columns
methods.description: Returns column definitions for POS sales payment report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate columns based on whether POS filter is active.

methods.name: get_pos_sales_payment_data
methods.description: Fetches POS invoice data and formats it for report output.

methods.name: get_sales_payment_data
methods.description: Fetches sales invoice data and payment details, formats data for report, with optional payment detail view.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_pos_invoice_data
methods.description: Retrieves POS invoice data with associated payment info from database.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice_data
methods.description: Retrieves sales invoice data from database.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Retrieves payment modes associated with invoices.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Fetches list of invoice IDs based on filters.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payment_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed payment mode data and adjusts for cash change amounts.
